failure_reason: Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome120) and tier (b) Playwright (headless plain, headless+--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, and fully headed non-headless) all received an Akamai edge 'Access Denied' block (errors.edgesuite.net) on every category listing page (e.g. /en_gb/home.html and /en_gb/home/shop-by-product/storage/baskets.html), so no rendered DOM, product count, or h1/canonical could be captured on any page. robots.txt and the XML sitemap endpoints (unprotected, static) were reachable and returned 200, so the category URL tree was built from the site's own sitemap instead. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome is confirmed disconnected (list_connected_browsers empty) per task instructions, so it was not attempted.
notes: ACCESS: tier (a) curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome120) reached robots.txt (200) and all *.sitemap.xml files (200) but got 403 Access Denied (Akamai) on every actual page (home.html and category .html pages). Escalated to tier (b) Playwright: headless plain -> Access Denied; headless with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled + webdriver-undefined init script -> Access Denied; headed (headless=False) with same flags -> Access Denied. Both tiers genuinely blocked on rendered content; tier (c) not attempted (disconnected per task brief). TREE: built from union of robots.txt-listed sitemap index (https://www2.hm.com/en_gb.sitemap.xml) -> 32 'subdepartment' sitemap shards (en_gb.pages.subdepartment.0-31.xml, 3009 URLs total) -> filtered to 340 URLs containing '/home/' (the Home department). Used the 'shop-by-product' branch as the canonical product taxonomy (Textiles, Bed Linen, Bath & Shower, Cooking & Dining, Storage, Kids & Baby, Furniture, Lighting, Decorations, Home Fragrance, etc.) since it mirrors a standard mega-menu structure; the parallel 'shop-by-room' branch (kitchen/, livingroom/, bedroom/, bathroom/, kids-room/, nursery/, outdoor/) and the 'sale/' branch expose the same underlying products filtered by room/discount rather than a distinct taxonomy, so they were treated as duplicate navigation paths and excluded per the duplicate-record rule (STEP 2.5 / textile.md 30 / storage.md 38). QTY: could not be obtained - every category page returned the Akamai block page before any product count rendered. Per STEP1 rule 3, qty=null with flag 'MANUAL REVIEW: ...' was used on every leaf row instead of fabricating a number; sitemap gave URLs only, no counts. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): Furniture (furniture/chairs, furniture/tables, furniture/storage/cabinets|wardrobes|shelves - explicitly under a Furniture URL branch per storage.md S21/27), Lighting (lighting/*), Decorations/Wall Decor (decorations/vases, mirrors, trays, frames, candles, posters, candleholders, decor-accessories, wall-decorations, books), Home Fragrance (candles, diffusers, room-spray), Kitchen & Dining non-textile items (kitchen-utensils, carafes-jugs, cutlery, cups-mugs, plates, glassware, serving-platters-bowls, chopping-boards, cookbooks, porcelain), Flowers & Plants, sleepwear/homewear (apparel/loungewear, not home textile), toys, giftwraps, premium/brands/sustainability pages, and all View All / Sale / Seasonal-Trending / Christmas Shop / Valentine Shop / Holiday / Deals / Offers-and-Highlights / Shop-by-Feature / Shop-by-Concept pages (promotional or collection landing pages, not standard category/subcategory listings, per textile.md S27 and storage.md S35). bath-shower/accessories.html was excluded as too generic to classify without page content (could be soap dispensers/bins, not confirmed storage or textile). cooking-dining/coasters-placemats.html was kept as Textile at LOW confidence because the site merges coasters (non-textile) and placemats (textile) into one category slug that cannot be split from the URL alone. Parent group rows (Textiles, Cushions, Carpets, Bed Linen, Bath & Shower, Towels, Cooking & Dining, Kids & Baby, Storage, Baskets) carry qty=null/link=null/evidence=null per grouping-row convention since each has recorded subcategory children.
